notes.title: Update 3 is LIVE
notes.notes:
We've pleased to announce another update is live for Mighty Monster Mayhem.  Here's what you can expect!

[h1]Hop-In Multiplayer[/h1]
We've added the ability to hop into the middle of any active multiplayer game!  This should make it a bit easier to find a match and team with others to reduce the cities to rubble.

[h1]Greatly Improved Chunk Ripping[/h1]
We've made monstrous (get it?) improvements in the consistency of ripping out chunks from buildings.  Now you can punch and rip buildings to the ground with greater efficiency.

[h1]Scaled Down Early Difficulty[/h1]
The first few levels of single player are now much, much easier to complete.  

[h1]Minor Bug Fixes[/h1]
Fixed an odd bug or two.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We're keeping an eye on performance, but we've also got plans for new game features and modes.  As always, your feedback helps shape our path forward.

notes.title: Update 2 is LIVE
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Update 2 for Mighty Monster Mayhem is live today.  We've been listening to player feedback, adding new features, and improving things in general for everyone.

[h1]Spectator Mode[/h1]
Mighty Monster Mayhem now has a spectator mode for watching or recording gameplay.  You can view the game from the players eyes, or switch away to a variety of cameras around the city.

[h1]Get Objectives Earlier[/h1]
We've removed the restriction on objectives that required you to play a level the second time.  Now, you can complete all the secondary objectives on your first play-through.

[h1]Prettier Buildings[/h1]
Our art team has done another pass on the destructible buildings to make them more vibrant and fun to destroy.

[h1]Huge Performance Improvements[/h1]
Our primary focus for this update was to maximize framerate.  We've seen as much as a 50% increase in framerate for some systems and will continue to improve on this as updates are released.

[h1]Next Up[/h1]
Expect another announcement soon with exciting new gameplay features, multiplayer updates, and lots of general VR fun!

notes.title: Update 1 is LIVE
notes.notes:
I wanted to give a quick thanks to everyone who's playing, and especially those players who are providing great feedback to make the game even better than it is.

The first update is live now so jump in and check it out!

[h1]Achievements are here![/h1]
MMM now has 127 achievements you can unlock.

Start earning them today by eating people, searching out hidden objects (and destroy them of course), or just play toss the human with friends in multiplayer.

[h1]Performance Optimizations[/h1]
This update also includes a variety of performance improvements to help people on min spec systems keep a steady 100FPS.

[h1]Coming soon[/h1]
Expect more updates soon with additional performance optimizations, bug fixes, new features and more!

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
We have seen conflicts with specific recording software configurations that may cause freezes during the game.  A known working configuration is OBS with hardware encoding.  We are looking further into this.
